gen-gf-underdog-gf-biz-udpgothic: BIZ UDPGothic reads approachable and modern, with lavish letter spacing and a clear channel leading into each round letter. Underdog adds display swagger up top, its lines like stitched thread.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-cairo: Modern in feel, Cairo opens a wide channel into every bowl. Underdog, expressive and commanding, bends its lines like tubing with no weight shift, a loud display voice over a quieter sans.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-cairo-play: Cairo Play reads clearly, its round letters staying open even at small sizes. Underdog gives its vertical and horizontal strokes identical weight, and once paragraphs pile up, the body underneath keeps going without fuss.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-catamaran: Loud meets loose: Underdog never swells or thins a stroke, while Catamaran lets its curvy letters feel unclamped. One shouts a little, the other lounges in the plain sans below.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-chakra-petch: Underdog brings expressive, commanding display letters, with no weight shift along any curve and a horseshoe-wide c. And Chakra Petch, a sans-serif with cupped round letters, carries paragraphs along with a professional, contemporary ease.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-chiron-hei-hk: Modern in spirit, Chiron Hei HK pulls its c open like a bracelet. But Underdog leads with strokes that never thicken or thin, and that trait gives the pair its swagger.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-elms-sans: Underdog is all expressive command, its c opened wide like a horseshoe, with no shift in weight along any curve. Elms Sans offers a ballpoint's plain line and see-through s.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-encode-sans-sc: Bent pipe up top: Underdog holds every stroke at constant width and opens its c like a horseshoe. Encode Sans SC does the quiet work, with a shallow curl and wide gap.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-encode-sans-semi-cond: Steady and showy at once: Underdog keeps an unvarying weight from word to word. Encode Sans Semi Condensed, a plain sans with an open counter on the s, tucks in beneath it.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-exo-2: Tubing-smooth and loud: Underdog has no thick-thin shift between downstrokes and curves. Exo 2 does the quieter job, giving the sans curves with plenty of daylight inside for text to breathe.
